configuration.selected_catalog: fixture_layers with fixtures/edges.pmtiles, zoom3, coordinates web_mercator, tile_edges merge, max_tiles64
configuration.scope_limitation: Complete for these explicit configurations only; future selected archives may add different table names or columns.

review_notes: Unconfigured fixed catalog has six functions (including COPY writer) and no tables/views. Selected edges.pmtiles configuration adds areas and roads tables. Complete snapshot is the union for these documented configurations: eight logical named surfaces. Arbitrary future tilesets have data-dependent names/schema; not assigned an invented global static denominator.
